cases.source_text: 道可道，非常道，名可名，非常名；
cases.translation: The way that can be spoken of is not the constant Way; the name that can be named is not the constant name.

cases.source_text: 無名，天地之始，有名，萬物之母。
cases.translation: Without name, it is the beginning of Heaven and Earth; with name, it is the mother of the myriad things.
